title: ReviewReportV1
$comment: Supplemental validation in ReviewReportContract enforces <=1000 UTF-16 code units per finding, non-blank strings, and max 65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes for the full report because JSON Schema maxLength counts code points and cannot express total serialized UTF-8 byte bounds.

score.description: Calculated review score between 0 and 100 inclusive.

findings.description: List of findings identified during review (0 to 50 items). Note: JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points; supplemental Java validation enforces <=1,000 UTF-16 code units, non-blank text, and overall serialized report <=65,536 UTF-8 bytes.

_tenvyr.description: Optional engine-injected metadata and usage evidence.
